recent: MISC 联合其他联合要约方及联合最终要约方，并于11月18日发布澄清新闻通知。同期，公司于8月27日公布2026年第二季度业绩，并宣派第二次免税中期股息每股8仙。
notable: MISC 联合其他联合要约方及联合最终要约方。

MISC 股东在 Yinson 交易上表达不满。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为47.934亿令吉，环比增长65.8%，同比增长76.1%；净利为11.543亿令吉，环比增长55.7%，同比增长148.6%；净利率为24.1%，低于上一季度的25.6%。

recent_en: MISC, together with other joint offerors and joint ultimate offerors, submitted a proposal to the board of Yinson Holdings Berhad on 6 November to acquire the remaining shares not already owned, and issued a clarification press notice on 18 November. In the same period, the company announced its 2Q2026 results on 27 August and declared a second tax-exempt interim dividend of 8 sen per share.
notable_en: MISC, together with other joint offerors and joint ultimate offerors, submitted a proposal to the board of Yinson Holdings Berhad to acquire the remaining shares not already owned.
MISC declared a second tax-exempt interim dividend of 8 sen per share.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple notifications of changes in its substantial shareholder transactions between August and November 2026.
MISC shareholders expressed displeasure over the Yinson deal.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was RM4,793.4 million, up 65.8% QoQ and 76.1% YoY; net income was RM1,154.3 million, up 55.7% QoQ and 148.6% YoY; net margin was 24.1%, lower than 25.6% in the previous quarter.
